purpose: Second pre-registered campaign, written after the first passed with most of its time budget unused: one lane per format, a larger mixed lane, two stress lanes that raise program length and the per-program cost budget toward the heartbeat and timeout limits, and a fresh positive-control lane. The exemplar lane already ran in the first campaign at the same Lean sources and is not repeated.
